name: Deplexo Free Hosting
free_limit: One always-on Free app: 0.25 vCPU, 128 MB RAM, 250 MB disk, 100 GB monthly transfer and 10 Mbit/s network bandwidth
watch_out: No payment card or automatic sleep on the Free plan, but resources are shared and capped at 0.25 vCPU, 128 MB RAM, 250 MB disk and 10 Mbit/s. At the 100 GB monthly account transfer limit, apps stop until the next month or a plan upgrade. No independent uptime guarantee; not a dedicated VPS.
